response.answer: A timeline, phased budget, and resourcing plan should include key milestones, estimated costs, and assigned personnel for each phase of the survey, case studies, workshops, and registry pilot. results.title: Perspective Chapter: UNFC and UNRMS – Global Tools Enabling ...
results.content: UNRMS aims to be the connector between a project-based classification using UNFC and a holistic management system grounded in the elements of the SDGs. Based on 12 fundamental principles and a set of requirements, UNRMS guides governments, companies, and financiers through the full resource life cycle—exploration, development, production, reuse, and closure—so that every decision can be tested against technical, social, environmental, and economic performance criteria drawn from the 2030 Agenda [41]. UNFC structures data and information to classify a resource project according to three main categories: the Environmental-Socio-Economic Viability (E Category), the Technical Feasibility (F Category), and the Degree of Confidence in the estimated quantities of potential production (G Category). UNRMS principles and requirements for responsible management of resources, coupled with UNFC classifications of actual and potential projects and production, provide a powerful approach to addressing the challenge of sustainable resource management.
